record_title: Exact first integral reveals a two-sided blow-up dichotomy for exponential memory
provenance: Source-specific correction and sharpening of the F2 exponential-memory model in arXiv:2609.15470v1 using an exact first integral and Gaussian-tail asymptotics.
limitations: The result applies only to F2 with a single exponential memory kernel. The v(0)>1 classification uses the real-valued model after it leaves the nonnegative biological state space, and no claim is made about F1 or F3. Originality is qualified to the best of our knowledge.
